cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, a message for the sons of Aaron, Moses's brother (Exodus 4:14). Aaron's sons are the priests, and this message is all about how they live. Tighten your apron strings, friend.

cards.question: The first rule for the priests is about death. True or false: A priest may defile himself for any dead person among his people.

cards.text: But there's an exception for his immediate family: his mother, father, son, daughter or brother.

cards.question: One more relative makes the priest's exception list. Who is it?
True or false: A priest may defile himself for those related to him by marriage.

cards.text: Next up: how a priest looks. Priests must not make bald spots on their heads or shave off the edges of their beards, and friend, as a stamper with THIS mustache, I read that verse and felt SEEN.

cards.question: There's a third thing the priests must not do to their own bodies. What is it?
God says the priests must be holy to Him and not profane His name. Why?

answers.text: They present the LORD's food offerings
They were born first in their families

cards.text: Then it gets personal: who a priest can marry. He must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.

cards.question: True or false: God says the priest is to be regarded as holy, because the LORD is holy.

cards.text: If a priest's daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father, and she must be burned in the fire. This one is heavy.
Now comes the priest who is highest among his brothers, the one with the anointing oil poured on his head. He must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.

cards.question: Regular priests could defile themselves for close family. True or false: The highest priest may defile himself for his father or mother.
The highest priest must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God. Why not?

answers.text: The anointing oil of his God is on him
He keeps watch over the gold inside
The people need him at the gate

cards.text: Then it's back to marriage, and the highest priest gets the EXTENDED edition of the list. The woman he marries must be a virgin.

cards.question: The highest priest is not to marry a ___, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution.
The highest priest is to marry a virgin from his own people. Why?

answers.text: So he does not defile his offspring
So his wife can serve beside him
So his family keeps its land

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses another message, this time for Aaron himself. It's for the generations to come, and it's about Aaron's descendants who have a physical defect.

cards.question: True or false: For the generations to come, a descendant of Aaron who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.

cards.text: Then God names the defects, like being blind or lame, or having a broken foot or hand. A descendant of Aaron who has a defect is not to come near to offer the food of his God.

cards.question: A descendant of Aaron with a defect can't offer the food of his God, but he's still one of Aaron's family. True or false: He may still eat the holy food of his God.

cards.text: But because of his defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar.

cards.question: Why must a descendant of Aaron who has a defect not go near the veil or approach the altar?

answers.text: So he won't desecrate God's sanctuaries
So the altar fire keeps burning
So he can rest from his work

cards.question: God said the priest is to be regarded as holy. When Moses passes along these rules for the priests, who does he tell?

answers.text: Aaron and his sons and all Israel

cards.text: Keep that apron ON, friend, because this teaching on holiness isn't done. I untied mine mid-batch once, leaned on the counter, and wore a flour print across my belly. ALL. DAY.
